defs.en: The people spoken, or written to, as an object.
defs.ex: Both of you should get ready now.

defs.en: (To) yourselves, (to) yourself.
The person spoken to or written to, as an object. (Replacing thee; originally as a mark of respect.)
The people spoken to or written to, as a subject. (Replacing ye.)
defs.ex: You are all supposed to do as I tell you.

defs.en: The person spoken to or written to, as a subject. (Originally as a mark of respect.)

ja: 近くにいる人、または対話している相手、書き送る相手。
特に相手を指定しないだれか。

defs.en: The individual or group spoken or written to.
defs.ex: Have you gentlemen come to see the lady who fell backwards off a bus?

defs.en: Used before epithets, describing the person being addressed, for emphasis.
defs.ex: You idiot!

defs.en: Your.
To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).
The name of the Latin script letter U/u.
Belonging to you; of you; related to you (singular; one owner).
defs.ex: Let’s meet tomorrow at your convenience.

defs.en: Belonging to you; of you; related to you (plural; more owners).
A determiner that conveys familiarity and mutual knowledge of the modified noun.
defs.ex: Not your average Tom, Dick and Harry.

defs.en: That; the specified (usually used with a human referent)
defs.ex: Your man just bought a new car.

defs.en: A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.
defs.ex: we moved to this town a year ago; I quit smoking exactly one year ago

defs.en: The time taken for the Earth to return to the same position along the ecliptic, completing a full cycle of seasons; a tropical year or solar year.
The time taken for the Earth to orbit the Sun with respect to the fixed stars; a sidereal year.
The length of twelve lunations; the time taken for any moon phase to happen twelve times; a lunar year.
The length of a year as marked by a calendar, 365 or 366 days in the Gregorian calendar; a calendar year.

ja: ある天体が別の天体に対して、公転する周期。

defs.en: A very long time.
defs.ex: It took years for the bus to come.

defs.en: In negative or interrogative use, often with an expectation or potential of something happening in the future.
defs.ex: I haven't finished yet.

defs.en: In negative imperative use, asking for an action to be delayed.
defs.ex: Don't switch it on yet – wait until I've reconnected the pump.

defs.en: At some future time; eventually.
defs.ex: The riddle will be solved yet.

defs.en: Not as of the time referenced.
defs.ex: I’ve yet to see him. — I have not yet seen him.

defs.en: In addition.
defs.ex: There are two hours yet to go until our destination.

ja: 更に。（stillより感情の強意が加わる）

defs.en: Nevertheless; however; but; despite that.
defs.ex: I thought I knew you, yet how wrong was I!

defs.en: A metal pan or boiler; yetling.
To get.
Used to show agreement or acceptance.
defs.ex: Yes, you are correct.

defs.en: Used to indicate disagreement or dissent in reply to a negative statement.
defs.ex: It was not my fault we lost the race. Oh, yes, it was!

defs.en: Answer to a question presuming one answer when all answers are correct.
defs.ex: Do you like cake, or pie? Yes.

defs.en: An exclamation of pleasure or approval, usually transcribed with an exclamation point.
defs.ex: Our second goal of the match! Yes!

defs.en: Response that confirms that the user is paying attention.
Used to ask for more information with a request.
defs.ex: I need some help. Yes?

ja: （強い歓喜、興奮）やったぁ、よぉし。

defs.en: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.
defs.ex: Was that a yes?

defs.en: A vote of support or in favor of something.
defs.ex: The workers voted on whether to strike, and there were thirty "yeses" and one "no".

defs.en: To agree with, affirm, approve.
defs.ex: Did he yes the veto?

defs.en: To say “yes”.
To attempt to flatter someone by habitually agreeing

ja: ゴマをすって付き従う。

defs.en: There is; indicating the existence of something.
Indicating the possibility or allowance of something.
In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.
defs.ex: a lamb is a young sheep

defs.en: At an early stage of existence or development; having recently come into existence.
defs.ex: the age of space travel is still young

defs.en: advanced in age; (far towards or) at a specified stage of existence or age.
defs.ex: How young is your dog?

defs.en: Junior (of two related people with the same name).
Early (of a decade of life).
Offspring, especially the immature offspring of animals.
defs.ex: The lion caught a gnu to feed its young.

defs.en: To become or seem to become younger.
To cause to appear younger.
To exhibit younging.
Yes.
defs.ex: —You wanna get pizza for dinner? —Yeah, all right.

defs.en: Used to express acknowledgment of what was previously said.
defs.ex: —You wanna get pizza for dinner? —Yeah, I think I'm gonna have leftovers instead.

defs.en: Used to ascertain the continued attention of the listener.
defs.ex: I was walking down the road, yeah, and you know what I saw, yeah? A dog wearing a dress!

defs.en: Expressing joy, celebration, glee, etc.
defs.ex: Yeah! We did it!

defs.en: to bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.
To vomit.
Your own self (singular).
defs.ex: Be careful with that fire or you'll burn yourself.

defs.en: You (singular); used emphatically, especially to indicate exclusiveness of the referent's participation in the predicate, i.e., that no one else is involved.
defs.ex: You yourself know that what you wrote was wrong.

defs.en: You (singular); even when "you" has not been used previously; see usage notes.
defs.ex: I spoke with yourself last in February.

defs.en: Oneself.
defs.ex: These days you have to watch yourself in the center of the city.

ja: あなた 自身、きみ自身
（二人称単数の）いつも通りの状態

defs.en: you will
you shall
